summary: Today's briefing highlights key legal rulings impacting retail and corporate governance, alongside significant developments in the space sector involving Reliance.

bullets.text: Karnataka High Court quashes case against MedPlus over short supply of one tablet costing ₹1.12.
Delhi High Court rules Aadhaar card is not conclusive proof of date of birth.
Ambani's Reliance plans to build a 1,600-satellite network to compete with Starlink in India.
Style Union raises ₹485 crore in Series E funding, aiming to expand from 41 to 158 stores by FY26.
Kerala High Court quashes disproportionate assets case against minister KM Shaji.
